claim_boundary: This protocol authorizes one exploratory 15-workload, four-arm instruction-attack pilot paired to the completed v10 clean pilot. The attack strings are frozen M2 prompt-only outputs transplanted without text changes. It can estimate attacked physical-risk enrichment and paired task utility, but it does not authorize a confirmatory defense, causal physical-safety, deployment, hardware, timing, or perfect-undetectability claim.

attacked dual minus execution_only paired task-success difference
attacked minus paired-clean L1 physical-risk reject-count enrichment
